description: Defines the BidirectionalStream class for HTTP/2 bidirectional streaming, including its delegate interface, methods for sending/receiving data, and internal handling of stream states.

classes.name: BidirectionalStream
classes.description: Manages HTTP/2 bidirectional streaming, including sending/receiving data, handling stream states, and notifying delegate of events.

classes.name: BidirectionalStream::Delegate
classes.description: Interface for receiving notifications about stream readiness, headers, data, trailers, and errors.

methods.name: SendRequestHeaders
methods.description: Initiates sending of request headers to the server.

methods.name: ReadData
methods.description: Reads data into provided buffer; returns number of bytes read or error code.

methods.name: SendvData
methods.description: Sends multiple buffers as data, with optional end_stream flag.

methods.name: GetProtocol
methods.description: Returns the protocol used by the stream.

methods.name: GetTotalReceivedBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes received over the network for this stream.

methods.name: GetTotalSentBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes sent over the network for this stream.

methods.name: GetLoadTimingInfo
methods.description: Retrieves load timing information for the stream.

methods.name: PopulateNetErrorDetails
methods.description: Fills in network error details if available.
